```{r}
#install.packages("ape")
#install.packages("phangorn")
#install.packages("seqinr")
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(seqinr)
library(tidyverse)
#BiocManager::install("ggtree", force=T, type = 'source')
library(ggtree)
```
#load data
```{r}
#load alignment from geneious prime
Poc.Seq <- read.dna("Sanger/20250128_Spawning_Poc_mtORF_alignment.fasta", format="fasta")
Poc_phyDat <- phyDat(Poc.Seq, type = "DNA", levels = NULL)

#calculate pairwise distance
Poc_dna_dist <- dist.ml(Poc_phyDat, model="JC69")

#run hierarchical clustering
hc <- hclust(Poc_dna_dist, "ward.D")

#cut tree in 5 species
clus <- cutree(hc,k=5)
g <- split(names(clus), clus)

#plot tree
p <- ggtree(hc,size=1) + 
   geom_tiplab(angle=0, hjust=0, offset=.03, show.legend=F, size=3, align=TRUE)+
   geom_treescale(x=1, y=1)

#save tree
pdf("output/Poctree.pdf", height = 12, width = 8)
groupOTU(p, g, group_name='Cluster') 
dev.off()
```
